description: Update any subset of the caller's profile fields.

avatar.description: Short token (single emoji glyph or alphanumeric tag).

bio.description: 0..500 chars of free-form text. Empty string clears it.

display_name.description: 1..32 chars, unicode allowed. Surfaces on leaderboard.

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

relays.description: JSON-stringified list of wss:// relay URLs (max 12).
